# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Lament over Jerusalem's Defilement

---

**1:1** I cried to the LORD in my great distress,
to God when sinners set upon me.

**1:2** Suddenly the noise of war arose before me;
'He will hear me,' I said, 'for I am full of righteousness.'

**1:3** I thought within my heart that I was full of righteousness,
for I had prospered and had many children.

**1:4** Their wealth was spread abroad throughout the earth,
and their glory extended to the ends of the earth.

**1:5** They were lifted up to the stars;
they said, 'We shall never fall.'

**1:6** They were arrogant in their prosperity
and had no understanding.

**1:7** Their sins were committed in secret;
I had no knowledge of them.

**1:8** Their lawless deeds exceeded those of the heathen before them;
they utterly defiled the holy things of the LORD.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal English rendering following Greek syntax. Poetic lineation preserved.*
